tldr: Venus in Cancer: love is protective, tender, and rooted in emotional belonging.
body: With Venus in Cancer, affection shows through care, memory, home, food, and the desire to make someone feel safe. You value devotion that feels emotionally real.
gift: Nurturing love, loyalty, emotional generosity, and the ability to create comfort.
challenge: Clinging, defensiveness, and using care to secure attachment.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
